definition: to make something work by flipping a switch
description: A young man in a yellow kurta walks backwards through a house at dusk, filming himself. He stops at a wall switch inside the veranda and flips it, then walks out into the garden past potted plants and palm trees to a switch box on a pole. He flips that one too and strings of fairy lights come on all across the house front, the palms and the garden, turning the blue evening bright. He looks up at the lights and grins.
